sec: sec:E001: AI failure plan for security breaches / Control shoulds

blocks.id: blk:E001: AI failure plan for security breaches / Control shoulds/1
blocks.text: Assigning a breach response lead from existing staff. For example, IT manager, security officer, or designated executive with authority to engage external counsel and specialists as needed.

sentences.text: Assigning a breach response lead from existing staff.
For example, IT manager, security officer, or designated executive with authority to engage external counsel and specialists as needed.

blocks.id: blk:E001: AI failure plan for security breaches / Control shoulds/2
blocks.text: Defining breach notification procedures. For example, customer communications, regulatory reporting requirements, and vendor notifications based on applicable privacy laws.

sentences.text: For example, customer communications, regulatory reporting requirements, and vendor notifications based on applicable privacy laws.

blocks.id: blk:E001: AI failure plan for security breaches / Control shoulds/3
blocks.text: Implementing security remediation measures. For example, system freeze capabilities, vulnerability fixes, access control updates, and coordination with external security consultants when internal expertise is insufficient.

sentences.text: For example, system freeze capabilities, vulnerability fixes, access control updates, and coordination with external security consultants when internal expertise is insufficient.

blocks.id: blk:E001: AI failure plan for security breaches / Control shoulds/4
blocks.text: Establishing evidence collection requirements with guidance on preserving evidence for potential legal review. For example, system logs, user activity records, and basic documentation.
